Class SaveFile

java.lang.Object
petgame.SaveFile
public class SaveFile extends Object
This class is responsible for loading and managing game save data from a TOML file. It provides methods to retrieve various attributes of the saved game, such as the pet's type, health, hunger, happiness, and other game-related statistics. Additionally, it supports fetching parental control settings and game session information from the config file.
